directions: From Mulhuddart, begin on the Blanchardstown Bypass and take the 1st left onto Old Navan Road
Take the next left to join the slip road follow the ramp straight ahead and bear slightly left back onto the Blanchardstown Bypass
Merge slightly right, stay on the bypass take the off ramp slightly left to exit
Turn left back onto Old Navan Road and follow it for about half a kilometre
